text.p: Following are the main stories in Thursday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- The Education Ministry will soon meet representatives from universities and private colleges in efforts to establish Malaysia as a regional hub for academic excellence.
-- Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said Malaysia Airlines could become one of the world's largest airlines if it had the will to succeed and worked with dedication.
-- The Malaysian Cabinet has decided not to ban the use of plastic bags as it would have far-reaching effects on the industry.
-- Mutiara Telecommunications has announced a further investment of 405 million ringgit in addition to the one billion to expand and upgrade its services.
